outcome: Final sweep in two PRs by risk. AR-10b (first, FINAL-SWEEP section 5): the universal permissions audit as permanent tests — server-action, desk-page and API-route auth inventories with reasoned fixtures, the customer A/B matrix on throwaway Postgres, and the session-deactivation browser extension; a real hole found is fixed at once in its own PR. AR-10a (second, sections 0-4 and 6): scripts/ar10-inventory.mjs, leftover desk screens converted to the kit, old components deleted once unimported, everyday plain words on every scanned file with reasoned allow-lists only, 390px added for desk routes with manual-only routes cut to token routes naming their spec, the O-3B approvals browser test (no-Stripe paths and the honest Approved-not-finished state), and visual review notes in STATUS. No business behavior changes anywhere.
acceptance: Server-action, desk-page and API-route inventory tests pass with every exception reasoned and test-backed
Customer A/B matrix covers every customer surface; archived and staff users get nothing; refused calls change nothing
Session removal/archiving takes effect on the next request (browser test)
scripts/ar10-inventory.mjs output in the AR-10a PR: zero desk pages outside migrated-pages.json
desk-navigation.ts, desk-sections.ts, GlobalSearchBox and every unused old component removed
The everyday plain-words list runs on every desk and portal file; the allow-lists hold only reasoned exceptions
Every page passes axe and no-sideways-scroll at 360, 390 and 1440 px in light and dark (inventory specs)
e2e/approvals.spec.ts: credit waits then approved once; refund declined; approved refund shows not finished
STATUS has the visual review notes
ci green at the exact head for each PR; every review comment read
invariants: AR-10a changes layout, words and kit components only: same URLs, same server actions, same domain reads; old URLs keep working
The audit never weakens a guard to make an inventory pass: an unguarded action is either guarded, or listed in the fixture with a reason and an existing refusal test
Public-by-design actions stay public only with their listed reason (rate-limited public form, invitation code, tenant link token, quote link language)
A real permission hole found on main is fixed immediately in its own PR (AGENTS section 6), never buried in the sweep diff
The approvals browser test proves no-Stripe paths only; the Stripe sending path stays proved by the O-3B database tests — never claim a refund was sent
Allowed plain-words exceptions are only the accountant area, legal document renderers and official form names, each with a written reason
Money stays integer cents through existing functions; the audit changes no money, tax or fee behavior
